messages.subject: Re: INLA weights
messages.body_plain:
I got an error when I used the scale parameter in the example model, I tried to use scale =1 and also scale=scalevar (a variable).
When I use scale=1 I got the following error:

Error: length(random.spec$values.order) == ns is not TRUE

When I used scale= scalevar (a variable) INLA stopped working.

Below is the model (the original example with the scale added):

n = 100

prec.y = 100

prec.obs = 10

prec.x = 1

scalevar=rnorm(n,0,1)

## true unobserved covariate

x = rnorm(n, sd = 1/sqrt(prec.x))

## the observed covariate

xobs = x + rnorm(n, sd = 1/sqrt(prec.obs))

## regression model using the unobserved 'x'

y = 1 + 4*x + rnorm(n, sd = 1/sqrt(prec.y))

## prior parameters

prior.prec = c(1, 0.01)

prior.beta = c(0, 0.1)

formula = y ~ 1 +

f(xobs, model="me",

hyper = list(

beta = list(

param = prior.beta,

fixed = FALSE

),

prec.obs = list(

param = prior.prec,

initial = log(prec.obs),

fixed = TRUE

),

prec.x = list(

param = prior.prec,

initial = log(prec.x),

fixed = FALSE

),

mean.x = list(

initial = 0,

fixed=TRUE

)

),

scale=1

)

r = inla(formula,

data = data.frame(y, xobs),

family = "gaussian",

control.family = list(

hyper = list(

prec = list(param = prior.prec,

initial = log(prec.y),

fixed=FALSE

)

)

)

)

summary(r)

messages.subject: Re: how to predict the stochastic volatility
messages.subject_clean: how to predict the stochastic volatility
messages.body_plain:
hi
to get the predicted marginal for the linear predictor you have to add one line to your data set as it is explained in the FAQ

http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-How-can-I-do-predictions-using-INLA-

You then get the marginal posterior for the linear predictor. If you want to get the marginal for the return in order to compute the VaR then you have to solve the one dimensional integral that is in equation 4 of the volatility paper

http://www.math.ntnu.no/~hrue/r-inla.org/papers/stochvol-nr.pdf

for this you have to write your own code as it is not included in the INLA library

Hope this helps

sara
